title: Alison
author: Anna V.
desc: 12 week strength program designed to put on muscle and hit all areas of the body.

ss.note: Super Set Hip abductions and adductions together. LEAN forward on the abductions.

ex.note: Plate under your heels, three second negative on the way down. Last rep should be hard.
10 full range and 10 partials, full range reps should be controlled with a 1 sec hold at the top
knee to armpit PLS and you can do this on a standard leg press just use one leg instead of both

ss.note: super set push downs with the over head ext on a cable.

ex.note: you can either use a dip machine or the assisted pull up machine to do bw dips. whichever floats your boat
lead with your hips. these should be HEAVY. DB is fine as well, make sure you brace your core and keep your chin tucked down
10 full range 10 partials. Lean forward and hug the handles to isolate the hammies
3 sec holds after each rep. Glutes should be on FIRE. 10 sec hold on the last rep
Use a DB and do a dumbell sumo squat. Hold it with your fingers. Make sure to keep your chin down and torso leaned forward makes a HUGE difference
